name: clickhouse-client
description: clickhouse-client — ClickHouse database CLI. Execute SQL queries, import/export data, manage ClickHouse servers.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/releases/latest/download/clickhouse-common-static-linux-amd64.tgz && tar xzf clickhouse-common-static-linux-amd64.tgz && sudo mv clickhouse-client /usr/local/bin/ && rm -rf clickhouse*
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub or official packages.
